name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA under which both parties may share and must protect each other's confidential information while evaluating a business relationship.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the Mutual NDA capturing the deal-specific terms: purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law and jurisdiction, modifications, and signatures.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard Terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability limits, indemnification, and term and termination.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard Terms for uptime and support response commitments for a cloud service, including service credits and remedies when targets are missed; incorporated into an Order Form.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard Terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under Statements of Work, covering deliverables, fees, intellectual property, confidentiality, and liability.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard Terms for licensing on-premise or downloadable software, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, liability, and termination.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard Terms governing how a processor handles personal data on behalf of a customer, covering GDPR and other privacy law obligations, subprocessors, security, and international data transfers.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard Terms for HIPAA-compliant handling of protected health information (PHI) by a business associate on behalf of a covered entity.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a commercial agreement addressing AI services, including use of customer input and output, restrictions on model training, and related obligations.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard Terms for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product before a full purchase, covering pilot access, restrictions, feedback, confidentiality, and liability.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard Terms for an early-stage design partnership in which a customer gets access to a product in development in exchange for providing feedback.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard Terms for a business partnership between a company and a partner, covering cooperation obligations, trademark licensing for joint marketing, fees, confidentiality, and liability.
